observations.why: The verb 'switching' frames a move from the known to the novel, appealing to novelty and change as the good.
The 10x performance claim appeals to mastery and capability while the cost framing positions a competitive advantage — achievement and standing as the appealed-to goods.
The arrow notation frames a directional transition from established to new, appealing to novelty as the good.
The 10x multiplier on analytical query performance appeals to mastery and capability of craft.
Setting a concrete timeline appeals to security and stability — pinning the change to a known schedule rather than leaving it open.
